title: Akodhano
text: 4 Pañcahi kho Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || 5 Saddho ca hoti hirimā ca hoti ottāpī ca hoti akodhano ca hoti paññavā ca hoti || || 6 Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam upapajjatī ti [page 244] 244 MĀTUGĀMA-SAṂYUTTAM [XXXVII. 16. 4 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || ||
